message.content: Pull up the supplier order for the fish delivery. I need to finalize it before the kitchen opens at 19:00.

content.text: I have the draft for the weekly fish order ready. It’s currently set for 400 euros, covering two kilos of sea bass and a kilo of red mullet. Would you like to adjust the quantities?

message.content: No, keep the quantities. But check the unit price on the red mullet. I remember it was higher last week.

content.text: Checking... The price has increased by 8% due to the seasonal shortage. The new total for the order is 432 euros. Do you want to approve this increase?

message.content: Yes, approve it. Now, look at the staff rota for tonight. Are we short on runners?

content.text: The rota shows Carlos is off tonight. We have two runners scheduled, but given the reservation count, you might need a third. Should I swap Elena from Saturday morning to tonight?

message.content: No, don't disrupt Elena's weekend. Just add a casual runner. Check the list of available part-timers.

content.text: I see three part-timers available for tonight. Luca is the most experienced. I’ve sent him a message to confirm. Shall I proceed with the order confirmation for the fish?

message.content: Yes, confirm the fish order. And send me the updated menu costing for the new sea bass dish so I can see the margin.

content.text: Order confirmed. The new sea bass dish costs 9.50 euros to produce. With your set price of 24 euros, the gross margin is 60.4%. This is within your target range.

message.content: Good. Send the final numbers to the kitchen display system.

content.text: Done. The kitchen display has been updated with the new menu price and the fish order confirmation. Anything else for tonight?
